NOTE 8313 Rasan is 8xxx but is NOT an insurer (Information Technology) - do not skip it. Never infer insurance from the 8xxx code range.
insurance.table_hint: An insurer's table has 'Insurance Revenues' and 'Result of Insurance Services' instead of Sales/Revenue and Gross Profit. If those appear for a company not on the list above, skip it and say so in the email rather than guessing.

annual._what: Annual announcements report the full year only. Q4 is the full year minus the nine months to 30 September; the second half is the full year minus the six months to 30 June.
annual.how: Both figures subtracted come from the company's OWN earlier announcement, fetched at run time - see prior_announcement.py. Nothing is read from the spreadsheet, so there is no setting to tune here.
annual.why_not_the_sheet: The sheet's earlier quarters are almost all VLOOKUPs into the Universe feed - measured 16 Aug 2026, 250+ of the 277 quarterly rows have a feed formula in Q1. Subtracting a feed figure from an announcement figure subtracts two different conventions and the result is not a quarter.
annual.if_the_earlier_announcement_is_missing: The figure is flagged and reported in the daily email. It is never filled in from the sheet instead.
